_how_to_edit: Edit text between the quotes. Keep commas between items and no comma after the last item in a list.
category must match one of the names in 'categories'.
diet can be "vegan", "vegetarian", or "" (blank for neither).
Set "available": false to hide an item or package without deleting it.
image can be a full web address or your own file, like "images/turkey.jpg". The emoji shows if the image can't load.
Packages: the guest slider highlights the package whose minGuests to maxGuests range fits. Use 0 and 0 to never auto-highlight.
Item photos are free-licensed images from Wikimedia Commons. Open the link and remove 'Special:FilePath/' and '?width=800' to reach the photo's page with its license and credit.
